title: H1-PAPER-COHORT-1 incident payload
description: Payload of one record in <lane>/evidence/paper_incident_ledger.jsonl. The envelope (seq, kind='incident', recorded_utc, prev_digest, digest) is research/fp/ledger.py CANONICAL_LEDGER_V1 and is not repeated here. Records are append-only; a mistake is corrected by an erratum, never an edit.

restart_counter.description: 0 at COHORT_START; +1 on every PROCESS_RESTART; never reset for the life of the cohort

open_trade_state.description: for restarts/reconciliation: trade ids and states read from the cohort DB before and after

host_bindings.description: COHORT_START only: H1_PAPER_LANE_DIR, H1_PAPER_STRATEGY_DIR, and the sha256 of each materialized strategy file

terminal_state.description: COHORT_TERMINAL only: PROSPECTIVE_BEHAVIOR and OPERATIONAL_CAPABILITY classifications
